slides.title: This Course Opens Multiple Routes
slides.content: Level 3 qualifications can lead to: University. Degree apprenticeships. Apprenticeships. Skilled employment. Further study. There is no single "correct" route.

slides.content: Possible progression routes include: Media Production degrees. Film degrees. Computing degrees. Cybersecurity degrees. Animation and Games degrees. Photography and Design degrees. Degree apprenticeships and employment are equally valid routes.

slides.content: Navigate contains: Your Digital CV. Skills Assessment results. Opportunities record. Placement evidence. Project evidence. Keeping Navigate updated makes future applications significantly easier.

slides.content: Applications and references are stronger when they include: Dated evidence. Project records. Placement records. Skills development. If an achievement is not recorded, it becomes harder to use later.

slides.content: "I want to work in games." "By half-term I will have produced one portfolio piece suitable for a games application." Goals include: Specific outcomes. A deadline. An action. A first step.
